Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up. Attaching our standard AP onboarding packet and PO mapping sample to this thread. Quick answers up front:

- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN on page 2 of the packet)
- W-9 is in the packet; if you need a different tax form for your vendor registry let me know
- Remit: Bank wiring instructions are in the packet; our preferred remit email for PDFs is invoices@redwood.com (we also support EFT).
- PO placement: Zenoria should include the PO number in the invoice header (Invoice -> PO #: single line) and in the invoice metadata field named "PO_REFERENCE" if your system supports mapping.
- VAT/evidence: For US entities VAT doesn't apply; if you operate EU entities we can provide VAT registration evidence for the appropriate legal entity.
- Consolidated billing: We can support consolidated monthly invoices that reference multiple POs. For PO matching, we will include a PO line-level map in the invoice XML/CSV export so your system can match by PO.

Notes: we've attached a small sample mapping file (po_mapping_sample.csv) that shows how we export PO links when we consolidate. If Zenoria's ERP requires one-to-one invoice-to-PO matching only, we can also emit single-PO invoices.

Attachments: redwood_ap_onboarding_packet_v1.pdf; po_mapping_sample.csv; vendor_registration_form_fillable.docx
